scenarios.title: A｜询问进度
scenarios.setting: 其他桌已经上菜，玩家等了比较久。

turns.prompt: 你想请服务员查询上菜进度，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, could you check on our order, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, could you check on our order, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Do you know how much longer our food will be?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer our food will be?
feedback.explanation: “How much longer”问还要多久，关注从现在起剩余的等待时间。

choices.text: We’ve been waiting for a while. Could you check for us?

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve been waiting for a while. Could you check for us?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you see if our order is almost ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you see if our order is almost ready?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Where is our food?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, could you check on our order, please?
feedback.explanation: 这句可催餐，但容易显得着急；报出还未上的菜并问预计时间，服务员更好查询。

turns.text: I’m sorry about the wait. Let me check with the kitchen.
It should be ready in about ten minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thanks for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s fine. We just wanted to make sure the order went through.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. We just wanted to make sure the order went through.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: All right. Could you let us know if it’s going to take much longer?

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Could you let us know if it’s going to take much longer?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Ten more minutes is okay. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ten more minutes is okay. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜某一道菜漏单
scenarios.setting: 其他菜都上了，唯独玩家的主菜一直没来。

turns.prompt: 你想提醒服务员还有菜没上，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think we’re still waiting for one dish.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think we’re still waiting for one dish.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: We haven’t received the seafood pasta yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: We haven’t received the seafood pasta yet.
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: I think one of our dishes may be missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think one of our dishes may be missing.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Could you check whether the seafood pasta was included in our order?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether the seafood pasta was included in our order?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: You forgot my pasta.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think we’re still waiting for one dish.
feedback.explanation: “You forgot”先认定是服务员遗忘；说意面还没上，再问进度，更方便核查。

turns.text: I’m sorry. Let me check your order.
You’re right. It looks like the pasta wasn’t sent to the kitchen.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long would it take if you put the order in now?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long would it take if you put the order in now?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Could you have it made as soon as possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you have it made as soon as possible?
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: Is there anything that could be prepared more quickly instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything that could be prepared more quickly instead?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: That’s okay. We’d still like the pasta.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. We’d still like the pasta.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

turns.text: We can have it ready in about fifteen minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「菜迟迟没有上」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. We’ll wait for it.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. We’ll wait for it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That’s fine. Please put the order in.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Please put the order in.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Fifteen minutes is a little long. Could we cancel it instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Fifteen minutes is a little long. Could we cancel it instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

scenarios.title: C｜决定取消
scenarios.setting: 在“菜迟迟没有上”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“决定取消”。

turns.prompt: 你想表达想取消尚未上桌的菜品，会怎么说？

choices.text: In that case, we’d like to cancel the pasta.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, we’d like to cancel the pasta.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Could you remove the pasta from our order, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you remove the pasta from our order, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I think we’d rather cancel it at this point.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we’d rather cancel it at this point.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Since it hasn’t been prepared yet, could we cancel it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Since it hasn’t been prepared yet, could we cancel it?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: We don’t want it now. Take it off.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, we’d like to cancel the pasta.
feedback.explanation: 这句要求取消但语气较硬；确认希望从订单中撤掉哪道菜，比“Take it off”更明确。

turns.text: Of course. I’m very sorry about that.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s okay. Please just make sure it isn’t included on the bill.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Please just make sure it isn’t included on the bill.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: No problem. Could you remove it from the bill as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Could you remove it from the bill as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: That’s fine. We’ll just have what we’ve already received.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. We’ll just have what we’ve already received.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
